company.name: Chatfuel
company.shortDescription: One solution for engagement and sales in private medicine and wellness
company.description:
Chatfuel is an AI-native operating system for private healthcare and wellness SMBs. It helps service teams shift from manual engagement to scalable revenue growth by reimagining the entire sales cycle.
Trained on over 150 billion customer conversations, Chatfuel empowers more than 18,000 businesses to automate and optimize their sales process - from first lead to loyal customer -in as little as 30 seconds.
In clinics and wellness centers, a multistage sales process often demands the business owner’s constant involvement, increasing the risk of client drop-off. Chatfuel solves this with a plug-and-play AI agent that captures leads directly from Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, and TikTok campaigns, qualifies them, schedules appointments, sends reminders, and manages follow-ups - all automatically.
Official Partner of Meta.
